Usage: agentcage cage [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage cages.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  audit    Query, filter, and summarize proxy audit logs.
  backup   Create a backup tarball of a cage.
  create   Build images, generate quadlets, install, and start a new cage.
  destroy  Stop containers, remove quadlets, state, and scoped secrets.
  edit     Edit a cage's stored config in $EDITOR, with validation and safe...
  exec     Run a command inside a cage container.
  grants   Manage Policy API runtime domain grants (see...
  har      Export captured HTTP traffic as HAR 1.2 JSON.
  list     List all cages with status.
  logs     Show journalctl logs for a cage.
  prune    Remove all exited interactive and ephemeral cages.
  restart  Restart services without rebuilding images.
  restore  Restore a cage from a backup tarball.
  run      Run a coding agent in a sandboxed cage.
  shell    Open an interactive shell in a cage container.
  show     Show cage configuration and status.
  start    Start a stopped cage.
  status   Show status — one cage's detail (with NAME) or all cages (without).
  stop     Stop a running cage without destroying it.
  update   Rebuild and restart an existing cage.
  verify   Check that a cage is healthy.

Aliases:
  config → edit
  delete → destroy
  describe → show
  inspect → show
  ls → list
  ps → list
  reload → restart
  rm → destroy
